$description: Component registry — the agent-resolvable inventory. Tool-gating rule: agents resolve components HERE and compose them; never rebuild a primitive. Each entry mirrors the shipped .jsx + .d.ts + .prompt.md trio. Namespace: window.<ns> from _ds_manifest.json.

components.aiPrompt: Primary action of any flow. Filled = the single primary CTA of a view; never stack two filled buttons. Loading swaps icon for spinner.
One per screen — the most important action. Carries the brand seed glow. Extended variant carries a label.
Icon-only limited to house/search/close/back, always with aria-label. 44px target regardless of glyph size.
2–5 options, short labels. Single-select replaces radio rows in toolbars; multi shows a check prefix.
Labels always visible, never placeholder-only. Errors explain how to fix. IDs/codes in mono. AI assist proposes a diff, never silently rewrites.
Multiple options only — a single binary choice is a Switch, never a lone checkbox.
3–5 mutually exclusive options; over 5 use Dropdown. Group carries a visible label.
One option → Switch, not checkbox. Effect immediate, no submit; loading while persisting.
Bounded numeric input; current value shown in mono beside the track.
6+ options or constrained space. Menu radius --radius-sm.
4px radius. Filter chips toggle with check prefix; only input chips are dismissible. Suggestion chips are the AI entry into search.
Counts in mono. Dot for unread only — never for risk status.
Initials fallback from the name; placeholder icon when no name. Never emoji.
Prefer container borders; divider only inside continuous lists.
Labels icon-only controls; never the only carrier of required info — touch has no hover.
Always pair with what's-happening text. Indeterminate escalates to 'still working' after 3s.
One action max. Errors that lose data use Dialog. Success carries circle-check-big + next step.
Surface + 1px border, radius 8–12; hover = border shift + optional -2px lift. AI content enters only via the footer slot (AIInsight). No gradients.
Leading avatar/icon; trailing switch/checkbox/icon. Row 56 comfortable / 40 compact.
Leading + content + trailing. Compose inside List.
Label–value pair; values mono when numeric or an ID. Copyable shows affordance on hover.
Sections DataRows under an 11px overline — never nested.
Stat + delta + trend. Number always mono, never hidden. Delta uses signal colours. Offline shows cached value + synced X ago.
Numeric columns right-aligned mono; headers 11px uppercase 0.1em. Sort indicator on the active column only.
Intent-prediction autocomplete when AI available. Clear affordance always visible.
Selected = check prefix + primary container. Always offer clear-all.
Primary for top-level views, secondary for sub-views.
4 tabs max, safe-area aware; icons + 11px labels; active uses primary-text.
56px, title + back + max 2 actions; icon-only actions limited to house/search/close/back.
Blocking decisions only; destructive confirm never default-focused.
Handle bar, drag dismiss, radius 16 top — the AI overlay's home on touch.
Icon + why-empty + one action — never a dead end. AI-empty echoes the query + 3 alternatives.
Mirrors the final layout; shimmer 1.6s; paired with what's-happening text.
The AI slot — tinted footer. Enforces Honest AI: what/why/confidence/override/disclaimer. Never silently rewrites content; errors carry a mono ref code.
Always beside AI output, never optional. Numeric % in mono + bar: ≥70 success, 50–69 warning, <50 error.
